page.overview:
What is Amalgamation?

The is the merged endoskeletons of Freddy Fazbear, Chica, Bonnie, Foxy, and Golden Freddy.

It was used as a source of remnant by William Afton to experiment on the moving of souls, and is a major protagonist/anti-hero in the third novel.

The Amalgamation is a mass of metal that is a melted, clumpy skeleton of metal bulges and blobs, barely resembling anything at all. It has extensions that can be interpreted as arms and legs, but with no defined mechanism of movement. The Amalgamation has no joints, no muscles, no skin or coverings, just masses of undefined tangles and cords, melted into one another and fused together. Most of it seems fused to the table it lays on, burned and blackened at the edges where it touches it, melting into and seemingly inseparable from it. A leg, finger, and eye socket can be seen in the melted mass. Its center glows orange.

In the graphic novel, the Amalgamation is depicted with the heads of Chica, Bonnie, Freddy Fazbear, and Foxy. Its body is worn and dull-colored, with holes revealing the inner workings featured across the rusted shell. Possibly resulting from the merging of four various animatronics, the Amalgamation features differences in limb design, as its left arm seems to be of Foxy's , while its right Bonnie's. Chica's cupcake is also fused with her head.
